table.retrieve:
Select manfcode As Code, Name
From Manufacturer
Where :as_selection = 'manfcode'
Union All
Select icatcode As Code, Name
From ItemCategory
Where :as_selection = 'icatcode'
Union All
Select iccode As Code, Name
From ItemClass
Where :as_selection = 'iccode'
Union All
Select packcode As Code, Name
From ItemPacking
Where :as_selection = 'packcode'
Union All
Select ISizecode As Code, Name
From ItemSize
Where :as_selection = 'isizecode'
Union All
Select IStylecode As Code, Name
From ItemStyle
Where :as_selection = 'istylecode'
Union All
Select IColourcode As Code, Name
From ItemColour
Where :as_selection = 'icolourcode'
Union All
Select IYarncode As Code, Name
From ItemYarn
Where :as_selection = 'iyarncode'
Union All
Select ISleevecode As Code, Name
From ItemSleeve
Where :as_selection = 'isleevecode'
Union All
Select IFabriccode As Code, Name
From ItemFabric
Where :as_selection = 'ifabriccode'
Union All
Select IBrandcode As Code, Name
From ItemBrand
Where :as_selection = 'ibrandcode'
Union All
Select IPartcode As Code, Name
From ItemPart
Where :as_selection = 'ipartcode'
Union All
Select IPartCode As Code, Name
From ItemPart
Where :as_selection = 'masteripartcode'
Union All
Select IPartcode As Code, Name
From (SELECT * FROM ItemPart WHERE IPARTCODE IN (SELECT DISTINCT OLDPARTCODE FROM ITEM)) A
Where :as_selection = 'oldpartcode'
Union All
Select Modelcode As Code, Name=left(Name, 60)
From Model
Where :as_selection = 'modelcode'
Union All
Select Genericcode As Code, Name
From GenericItem
Where :as_selection = 'genericcode'
Union All
Select Authorcode As Code, Name=left(Name, 60)
From Author
Where :as_selection = 'authorcode'
UNION ALL
SELECT ItemAlertCode AS Code, Name
FROM ItemAlert
WHERE :as_selection = 'itemalertcode'
UNION ALL
SELECT DiseaseCode AS Code, Name
FROM Disease
WHERE :as_selection = 'diseasecode'
UNION ALL
SELECT DiseaseTypeCode AS Code, Name
FROM DiseaseType
WHERE :as_selection = 'diseasetypecode'
